What if…?

About the model

R² (hold-out)0.857
Mean abs. error0.38 pts
RMSE0.50 pts
Trees200
  • Random Forest trained on 4,998 student survey rows (duplicates removed, negative activity hours set to 0), evaluated on a 30% hold-out set.
  • Daily social media hours dominate (about 73% of importance), then sleep (10%), phone unlocks (4%) and country (3%). Stress level contributes under 1%.
  • “Likely range” is the 10th–90th percentile of the individual trees’ predictions.
  • This is observational data: patterns are not proof of cause. Predictions are only reliable for ages 18–24 and inputs within the sliders’ ranges.

For education only. This is not a diagnosis. If you or someone you know is struggling, please talk to a counsellor, doctor, or someone you trust.
